components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single decisive brass action in a composition.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:48px; padding:0 20px; border:1px solid var(--accent, #b78b3e); border-radius:0; background:var(--accent, #b78b3e); color:var(--accent-contrast, #121212); font:600 11px/1 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; transition:background-color .2s,border-color .2s,color .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--accent-hover, #76531e); border-color:var(--accent-hover, #76531e); color:var(--accent-hover-contrast, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #b78b3e); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A square secondary action that inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height:48px; padding:0 20px; border:1px solid var(--foreground, #121212); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--foreground, #121212); font:600 11px/1 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; transition:background-color .2s,color .2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:var(--foreground, #121212); color:var(--background, #f2f1ed); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #b78b3e); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Booking Field
components.description: A visible factual label and native control inside a connected planner.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; padding:16px 20px; border:1px solid var(--control-border, #86817a); border-radius:0; background:var(--surface, #fff); color:var(--foreground, #121212); } .ds-field span { font:500 11px/1.4 'Azeret Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted, #68655f); } .ds-field input { border:0; outline:0; background:transparent; color:inherit; font:500 16px/1.5 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #b78b3e); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Quiet uppercase navigation with one active hairline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:28px; min-height:80px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border, #d6d2ca); background:var(--background, #f2f1ed); } .ds-nav a { padding:8px 0; color:var(--foreground, #121212); text-decoration:none; font:500 11px/1.4 'Azeret Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.1em; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:var(--accent-strong, #76531e); } .ds-nav-active { border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent, #b78b3e); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #b78b3e); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Stay Planner
components.description: A connected architectural row of stay criteria and one brass action.
components.css: .ds-planner { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1.25fr auto; border:1px solid var(--border, #d6d2ca); background:var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-planner label { display:grid; gap:8px; padding:20px; border-right:1px solid var(--border, #d6d2ca); color:var(--muted, #68655f); font:500 11px/1.4 'Azeret Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.12em; } .ds-planner input,.ds-planner select { border:1px solid var(--control-border, #86817a); background:var(--background, #f2f1ed); color:var(--foreground, #121212); font:500 18px/1.5 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-planner button { min-width:192px; border:0; border-radius:0; background:var(--accent, #b78b3e); color:var(--accent-contrast, #121212); font:600 11px/1 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.11em; } .ds-planner button:hover { background:var(--accent-hover, #76531e); color:var(--accent-hover-contrast, #fff); } .ds-planner :focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #b78b3e); outline-offset:3px; }

components.css: .ds-room { display:grid; grid-template-columns:7fr 5fr; gap:32px; padding:48px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--border, #d6d2ca); background:transparent; color:var(--foreground, #121212); } .ds-room-image { aspect-ratio:16/10; background:var(--surface-muted, #e9e7e1); } .ds-room small,.ds-room strong { font:500 11px/1.4 'Azeret Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.12em; color:var(--muted, #68655f); } .ds-room h3 { margin:12px 0 0; font:500 48px/.94 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.04em; } .ds-room p { max-width:28rem; color:var(--muted, #68655f); font:400 14px/1.75 Manrope, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The visual system treats the property as the identity. Large, truthful photographs sit inside a measured field of chalk, carbon, hairline rules, and restrained brass. The atmosphere is calm and exact rather than ornamental: architectural scale and whitespace communicate luxury while the content remains direct and hospitable.

The system is editorial but not magazine-like for its own sake. Display type establishes place and proposition; compact mono text is reserved for factual metadata, rates, locations, and state. Interfaces stay square, low-shadow, and visibly structured. Dark mode preserves the same hierarchy instead of becoming a separate visual language.
keyCharacteristics: Real property photography at architectural scale
Twelve-column desktop composition with disciplined mobile reduction
Warm neutral grounds, carbon type, and one restrained brass accent
Square controls, one-pixel rules, generous whitespace, and minimal depth
Factual hospitality language with explicit booking states

rules.name: The Brass Economy Rule
rules.body: Brass identifies the primary action or a small factual accent; it does not spread across backgrounds, decoration, and body copy at once.

rules.name: The Theme Equivalence Rule
rules.body: Light and dark modes preserve semantic hierarchy, contrast, and photographic prominence rather than swapping to a new aesthetic.

rules.name: The Factual Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono labels must communicate a location, state, category, field, or measurable fact; they are not generic pre-heading eyebrows.

rules.name: The Display Restraint Rule
rules.body: Use one display-scale statement per view and keep tracking no tighter than the established display setting.

rules.name: The Aligned Edge Rule
rules.body: Prefer shared baselines, hairlines, and grid edges over extra containers or decorative separators.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If a border, tonal shift, or image plane communicates hierarchy, do not add a shadow.

dos: Do let verified property photography and generous whitespace carry the premium character.
Do use brass sparingly for a primary action or factual emphasis.
Do keep metadata concise, uppercase, and genuinely informative.
Do preserve square geometry, one-pixel rules, and strong alignment across themes and breakpoints.
Do qualify rates, availability, and booking state exactly as the underlying workflow supports.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glassmorphism, pill-heavy controls, or routine card shadows.
Don't use mono labels as decorative eyebrow copy above every heading.
Don't invent hotel facts, availability, reviews, awards, or event schedules.
Don't animate every element or hide essential content before JavaScript or scroll triggers run.
Don't substitute generic stock imagery for verified resort photography.
